# Motion — full agent brief

Use on-device iPhone body-pose tracking to control a screen-mirrored game without transmitting camera frames.

## Index

# Motion

Use your body as a game controller.

## Product boundary

- An iPhone performs body-pose detection on device
- The game runs on the phone and can be screen-mirrored to a TV
- Only normalized joints can enter the parked relay preview; camera frames are never transmitted or stored
- The internal game, camera, and room routes are not public website surfaces
